Nodes further from the center (complex) are sorted to the start of the array (drawn first/background), while simple nodes are sorted to the end (drawn last/foreground) to prevent 'ghost' nodes from obscuring primary notes.

Implement strict visual hierarchy in rendering. 3-Limit lines are drawn thickest (2.5x), 5-Limit medium (1.5x), others thin (1.0x). Added harmonic neighbor highlighting on hover (halo effect) to reduce visual clutter.
